page_title: FUL 2-0 NEW | Fulham v Newcastle 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) picks up a yellow card.
90+5' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
90+5' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
90+3' The game is interrupted as Joshua King (Fulham) is flagged offside.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.

90' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post.
89' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) picks up a yellow card.
89' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.
86' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Issa Diop is replaced by Jorge Cuenca (Fulham).
84' Dan Burn comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alex Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
83' Harry Wilson (Fulham) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Nick Pope scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
82' Joshua King (Fulham) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Nick Pope has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
80' 2 - 0 Tom Cairney (Fulham) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the left post in trademark fashion.
80' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) works the corner short.
80' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Fulham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
77' Here is a change. Nick Woltemade is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Sean Neave (Newcastle Utd).
77' The corner is swung in but Newcastle can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

76' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

75' Joshua King (Fulham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Robert Jones with no other option than to blow for a foul.
74' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Tom Cairney (Fulham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
72' Substitution. Joshua King (Fulham) replaces Emile Smith Rowe.
72' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harry Wilson (Fulham) replacing Oscar Bobb.
72' The game has come to an end for Rodrigo Muniz. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Raul Jimenez (Fulham).
70' Robert Jones shows the yellow card to Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) for a heavy challenge.

70' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Nick Pope, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
69' A long pass finds Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
66' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Bruno Guimaraes will be replaced by Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd).
66' Substitution. Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) in, William Osula out.
64' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
63' Tom Cairney (Fulham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
60' Marco Silva is forced to make a change. Kevin (Fulham) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Tom Cairney.
58' Kevin (Fulham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Robert Jones blows his whistle. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
49' Newcastle can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is knocked off balance by a defender near the penalty spot and sends his header from the corner well wide of the right post.
48' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

47' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
46' Eddie Howe makes a switch. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is coming on in place of Jacob Murphy at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
42' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
41' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Jones interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
38' Kevin (Fulham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
35' Looks like Kevin (Fulham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
33' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Bernd Leno is alert and denies him with a nice save.
31' The ball is laid off to Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Bernd Leno to make a decent save.
28' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
26' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
25' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Newcastle earn a corner.
24' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Nick Pope.
23' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
20' 1 - 0 Issa Diop (Fulham) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 1:0.
19' OFF THE BAR! Kevin (Fulham) strikes a brilliant shot towards goal from the free kick, but his effort rattles the crossbar.
18' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Fulham have a free kick.
17' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) makes a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends the corner into the box, but Nick Pope intercepts it and averts the threat.
15' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play and Fulham manage to earn a corner.
11' Fulham fail to score from a corner as Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) leaps to collect the ball.

10' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.
9' Kevin (Fulham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
6' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
3' Newcastle take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

3' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
1' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Fulham will take the kick-off.
Robert Jones was nominated as the referee for this game.
